purpose: Developer microbenchmark for the 0.3 indexing and accounting changes; informational, not a release threshold.

policy_predicate.workload: 200 teams, five members, 100 sequential steps per team, 20,000 unique request ids

discovery.workload: 2,000 unrelated live lineages followed by one three-message extension

notes: The policy comparison produced the same retained-decision count before and after optimization.
Discovery semantics were also compared against the pre-index implementation on all 23 available JSONL traces (8,833 requests); member and final-team assignments were identical.
